description: Use this when the user wants a new presentation made from a prompt in their connected PitchBoost account: a sales or investor pitch, a proposal, a report or update, a talk, or a lesson or class presentation, in any language. It is designed in the brand saved in the account or, when none is saved, in the logo, colors and fonts read from the address in website. It returns a share link at once: the deck is written in the background over a few minutes, and the link shows a progress page until it is ready. If the deck is for a business, the account has no saved brand and no website was given, the first call makes nothing and returns one question to put to the user (their company's website, which they can skip); call again with the answer. If the user has not connected a PitchBoost account, or declines to connect one, use create_sample_deck instead: it makes the same kind of deck with no account. To redesign a deck the user already has, use rebuild_deck.

kind.description: Deck type. Defaults to pitch_deck, a slide presentation for any purpose.

prompt.description: What the presentation is about, who will see it, and what it should achieve. For a pitch, include the company, the offer and the audience.

skip_website.description: Set to true only when the user was asked for their website and chose to skip, or said they have none. The deck is then designed without a brand read from a website.

website.description: The website of the business or organization presenting the deck (the user's own), for example acme.com. PitchBoost reads its logo, colors and fonts so the deck is in that brand. Pass only an address the user gave. Never a customer's, a prospect's or a source's website, and never a guess.

name: create_deck
title: Make a new presentation
